description: Golden SYNC_COMMITTEE_CONTRIBUTION_AND_PROOF sign requests on the end-to-end network (minimal preset). Every root was computed by qrysm's own code; request_json is the canonical body of docs/contract.md section 8. Generated by tools/vectorgen; data only, dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

cases.name: single_bit_first
cases.notes: Computed with qrysm's mainnet SSZ code over the 2-byte minimal bitvector padded to 16 bytes (qrysm has no minimal-preset SSZ code outside Bazel's --config=minimal). Both bitvectors fit one chunk, so the roots are equal, but this record is not authoritative. object_ssz_hex is the padded mainnet encoding.
